tennessee/nashville.title: Nashville Farmers Markets - {count} Markets, Days and Hours
tennessee/nashville.description: {count} farmers markets in Nashville, TN with days, hours and parking. Nashville Farmers' Market is open Friday-Sunday and doubles SNAP up to $100.

tips.label: Year-round
tips.text: The farm sheds at Nashville Farmers' Market run Friday-Sunday all year: 9am-2pm March-October and 10am-2pm November-February.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: Nashville Farmers' Market has free 2-hour parking on site and along 7th Ave. State government lots nearby are free on Saturdays and Sundays.

tips.label: By bus
tips.text: WeGo buses stop in front of Nashville Farmers' Market on Rosa L. Parks Blvd.

tips.label: SNAP doubled
tips.text: Fresh Bucks at Nashville Farmers' Market matches SNAP $1 for $1, up to $100, at the info booth in Farm Shed 1 on weekends from 10am-2pm.

tips.label: Winter Saturdays
tips.text: Richland Park Farmers' Market runs every Saturday, rain or shine: 9am-12pm April-December and 10am-12pm January-March.

tips.label: Late season
tips.text: East Nashville Farmers' Market keeps going on Tuesdays through December 22, 2026, from 3:30pm-6pm, with free parking on site.

faqs.question: Is the Market House at Nashville Farmers' Market open every day?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Market House building is open daily from 8am-8pm, though each restaurant and shop inside sets its own hours.

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog to a Nashville farmers market?
faqs.answer: East Nashville Farmers' Market welcomes pets, but asks that dogs wear foot protection on hot summer asphalt.

faqs.question: Where is the East Nashville Farmers' Market?
faqs.answer: At 5th and Woodland (511 Woodland Street). Extra free lots are at 6th and Main St and at First Church of the Nazarene across the street.

faqs.question: How big is Richland Park Farmers' Market?
faqs.answer: It has 80+ vendors in peak season, from farmers and bakers to cheese makers, chefs and food entrepreneurs.

ohio/columbus.title: Columbus, OH Farmers Markets: Saturday and Holiday Markets
ohio/columbus.description: Columbus, OH farmers markets with days and hours. German Village and Clintonville run Saturdays through Nov 21, then Clintonville moves indoors in December.

tips.label: Late season
tips.text: German Village (Saturdays 9am-1pm, 555 S Third St) and Clintonville (Saturdays 9am-12pm) both run through November 21, 2026.

tips.label: Holiday market
tips.text: Clintonville's Holiday Market moves inside North Broadway United Methodist Church on Saturdays December 5, 12 and 19, from 9am-1pm.

tips.label: SNAP match
tips.text: Clintonville Farmers Market matches SNAP $1 for $1, up to $25, on your Ohio Direction Card (EBT). WIC farmers market coupons are welcome too.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: Clintonville Farmers Market (3535 N High St) has free parking at Columbus Mennonite Church and on side streets, plus a free bike corral on Orchard Ln.

tips.label: Produce Perks
tips.text: The Conservatory Farmers Market at Franklin Park Conservatory takes EBT and adds Produce Perks dollars for fresh produce. It runs Wednesdays, June-September.

tips.label: Pearl Market
tips.text: Pearl Market in the Gay Street District has ended after 26 years. Downtown's weekday market is now Thursdays 11am-2pm at Columbus Commons (160 S High St).

faqs.question: Are there farmers markets on weekday evenings in Columbus?
faqs.answer: In summer, yes. Bronzeville Growers Market runs Thursdays 3pm-6pm at 925 Mt Vernon Ave (July 2-Sept 24), and Franklin Park Conservatory hosts a market on Wednesdays 3:30pm-6:30pm (June 3-Sept 16).

faqs.question: Is there a farmers market on the West Side of Columbus?
faqs.answer: Westgate Farmers Market sets up at 2925 W Broad St on the 1st and 3rd Saturdays of each month, June through October, from 9am-12pm.

minnesota/minneapolis.title: Minneapolis Farmers Markets: Winter Markets, Days and Hours
minnesota/minneapolis.description: {count} farmers markets in Minneapolis, MN with days and hours. Mill City and Northeast move indoors for winter, and the Lyndale market runs May-Oct, Wed-Sun.

tips.label: Biggest market
tips.text: The Minneapolis Farmers Market at 312 E Lyndale Ave N runs May 2-Oct 31 in 2026: Wednesday-Friday 7am-1pm, Saturday and Sunday 6am-1pm.

tips.label: Winter
tips.text: Mill City's last outdoor market is Oct 31. From Nov 7 it moves inside the Mill City Museum on the 1st and 3rd Saturdays, 9am-1pm, through April. Entry is free.

tips.label: Holiday season
tips.text: Mill City's indoor markets before the holidays fall on Nov 7, Nov 21, Dec 5 and Dec 19. There is no market on Saturday, Jan 2.

tips.label: Southwest winter
tips.text: Neighborhood Roots runs winter markets indoors at Bachman's, 6010 Lyndale Ave S, 10am-1pm on Nov 14, 2026, then Jan 9, Feb 6 and Mar 13, 2027.

tips.label: SNAP match
tips.text: At Mill City's Info Booth, SNAP/EBT is triple matched year-round: buy $10 in tokens and get $40 to spend.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: Mill City: the Mill Quarter ramp across the street has a $3 Saturday special (in before 10am, out by 1pm). The US Bank Stadium light rail stop is two blocks away.

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog to Mill City Farmers Market?
faqs.answer: Outdoors, leashed dogs (6 feet or shorter) are welcome in the open Chicago Mall between the Guthrie and the museum, but not under the covered Train Shed. Dogs are not allowed at the indoor winter market.

faqs.question: Is there a winter farmers market in Northeast Minneapolis?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Northeast Minneapolis Farmers Market meets the first Saturday of each month, November through April, 10am-1pm at East Side Neighborhood Services, 1700 2nd St NE.

faqs.question: How old is the Minneapolis Farmers Market?
faqs.answer: It started in 1876 at First Street and Hennepin Avenue. The Lyndale market, with its three red sheds, opened in 1937 and now has 170 stalls shared by more than 100 vendors.

faqs.question: Does the Minneapolis Farmers Market on Lyndale take EBT?
faqs.answer: Yes, in season. Swipe your card at the EBT booth for tokens, and Market Bucks match SNAP spending dollar for dollar, up to $10 per visit.

texas/houston.title: Houston Farmers Markets: Open Year-Round, Days and Hours
texas/houston.description: {count} farmers markets in Houston, TX with days and hours. Urban Harvest runs every Saturday year-round, and the Airline Drive market is open daily.

tips.label: Year-round
tips.text: Urban Harvest Farmers Market at 2752 Buffalo Speedway runs every Saturday, 8am-12pm, year-round, rain or shine.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: Urban Harvest has free parking in the garage, with 500+ spaces. Enter from W. Alabama St or Westheimer Rd.

tips.label: SNAP match
tips.text: Bring your Lone Star Card to the Urban Harvest info booth: Double Up matches SNAP dollar for dollar, up to $40 a day, in produce credit.

tips.label: Open daily
tips.text: The Houston Farmers Market at 2520 Airline Dr is open every day, 6am-7pm, but each merchant sets its own hours. It does not take SNAP/EBT, and most vendors prefer cash.

tips.label: Sundays
tips.text: Heights Mercantile, 714 Yale St, hosts a farmers market every 2nd and 4th Sunday, 9am-1pm.

tips.label: Farm visit
tips.text: Hope Farms, 10401 Scott St, opens to the public on the first Saturday of every month, 9am-2pm, with produce picked right before market day.

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog to a Houston farmers market?
faqs.answer: Not to Urban Harvest or the Houston Farmers Market on Airline. Both ban pets under health rules; Urban Harvest allows service animals.

faqs.question: Where does the food at Urban Harvest come from?
faqs.answer: Only from farmers and food vendors within 180 miles of Houston. Crafts and reselling are not allowed, and since not every farm is certified organic, each booth posts its growing practices.

faqs.question: How old is the Houston Farmers Market?
faqs.answer: It was established in 1941 in the Greater Northside District and calls itself the largest and oldest farmers market in Houston.

faqs.question: Where else can I use Double Up Food Bucks in Houston?
faqs.answer: Freedman's Town Farmers Market, 1108 Victor St, on Saturdays 9am-2pm, and the Acres Homes Farmers Market, 2500 S Victory St, on the 3rd Saturday, 10am-1pm. Double Up credit does not expire.

california/los-angeles.title: Los Angeles Farmers Markets: Year-Round Days and Hours
california/los-angeles.description: Los Angeles farmers markets with days, hours and parking. Hollywood runs Sundays 8am-1pm with 150+ vendors, plus weeknight markets Tuesday to Friday.

tips.label: Biggest market
tips.text: Hollywood Farmers' Market, 1600 Ivar Ave at Selma Ave, runs Sundays 8am-1pm with over 150 farmers, producers and food vendors. It has been going since 1991.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: Get Hollywood market parking validated at the info booth: $6 at the Sunset & Vine garage (enter from Morningside Ct) or $7 at Sunset and Ivar.

tips.label: By Metro
tips.text: Hollywood is a 2-block walk from the B Line's Hollywood/Vine stop. The Thursday LA River market sits next to the A Line's Chinatown station.

tips.label: SNAP match
tips.text: Market Match adds to CalFresh EBT: up to $25 a day at LA River, $15 a day at Echo Park, and $15 a week at Hollywood and Atwater Village.

tips.label: After work
tips.text: Old LA in Highland Park runs Tuesdays 3pm-8pm (3pm-7pm in winter), LA River on Thursdays 3pm-7:30pm with free parking, and Echo Park on Fridays 3pm-7:30pm.

tips.label: Holidays
tips.text: Food Access LA markets stay open most holidays but close Thursday and Friday of Thanksgiving weekend (Nov 26-27, 2026) and on Christmas.

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog to a Los Angeles farmers market?
faqs.answer: Usually not. Food Access LA markets, including Hollywood, Atwater Village and Echo Park, allow only service animals, and Larchmont Village posts a no-dogs sign.

faqs.question: Do LA farmers market vendors take cards?
faqs.answer: At Food Access LA markets most vendors take debit or credit cards and apps like Venmo, and Hollywood and Atwater Village have ATMs. At Larchmont Village most vendors want cash, so bring small bills.

faqs.question: Is there a farmers market in Larchmont Village?
faqs.answer: Yes, at 209 N Larchmont Blvd on Wednesdays 12:30pm-4:30pm and Sundays 10am-2pm. There is free underground parking by the Rite Aid across the street.

faqs.question: Is there a Sunday farmers market in downtown LA?
faqs.answer: Historic Downtown LA Farmers Market sets up every Sunday from 10am-3pm on 5th St, between Broadway and Main St.

pennsylvania/allentown.title: Allentown, PA Farmers Markets: Year-Round and Winter Markets
pennsylvania/allentown.description: Allentown, PA farmers markets with days and hours. The Fairgrounds market is open Thursday-Saturday all year, and Emmaus and Easton run into December.

tips.label: Year-round
tips.text: Allentown Fairgrounds Farmers Market, 1825 W Chew St, is open year-round: Thursday 9am-7pm, Friday 8am-7pm and Saturday 8am-6pm.

tips.label: Indoors
tips.text: The Fairgrounds market is indoors, with over 50 local merchants selling produce, butcher meats, poultry, seafood and sushi, baked goods, deli and hot food to eat in or take out.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: The Fairgrounds market has free parking on site, with room for motorcoaches too.

tips.label: Sundays
tips.text: Emmaus Farmers' Market at Triangle Park, just south of Allentown, runs every Sunday 10am-1pm through November and 10am-12pm every Sunday in December.

tips.label: Winter
tips.text: From January to April, Emmaus keeps its market outdoors at the Triangle on the 2nd and 4th Sundays, 10am-12pm, rain, snow or shine.

tips.label: Easton
tips.text: Easton Farmers' Market, going since 1752, sets up at Scott Park (128 Larry Holmes Dr) on Saturdays 9am-1pm through Dec 19, 2026, with 10am-12pm hours in December.

faqs.question: Is there a farmers market near Allentown that doubles SNAP?
faqs.answer: Easton Farmers' Market runs a Red EBT Tent for Pennsylvania and New Jersey cards, and matches SNAP purchases up to $10 with Fresh Food Bucks for fruits and vegetables.

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog to the Easton Farmers' Market?
faqs.answer: Yes. Easton welcomes pets as long as owners follow state and city rules. Every vendor takes cash, while cards and mobile pay vary by stand.

faqs.question: Where do I park for the Emmaus Farmers' Market?
faqs.answer: Schantz Funeral Home lets shoppers use its Third Street lot for free on Sundays, and street parking around the Triangle is free. Accessible spaces are in front of Morty's Steaks.

faqs.question: Where do I park for the Easton Farmers' Market?
faqs.answer: Shoppers park free on Saturdays from 9am-1pm in the Riverstar Properties lots and at 101 Larry Holmes Drive, a short walk from Scott Park.

north-carolina/raleigh.title: Raleigh, NC Farmers Markets: Open Daily and Winter Markets
north-carolina/raleigh.description: {count} farmers markets in Raleigh, NC with days and hours. The State Farmers Market is open 7 days a week all year, with free parking and indoor shops.

tips.label: Year-round
tips.text: The State Farmers Market, 1201 Agriculture St, is open all year: Monday-Saturday 5am-7pm and Sunday 8am-5pm.

tips.label: Indoors
tips.text: Its Market Shoppes is a climate-controlled building with meats, cheeses, bakery items, ice cream, coffee and N.C. wines, next to the 30,000 sq ft Farmers Building.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: Parking at the State Farmers Market is free and on site.

tips.label: Breakfast
tips.text: The State Farmers Market Restaurant serves breakfast and lunch Monday-Saturday 6am-3pm and Sunday 8am-3pm. The N.C. Seafood Restaurant stays open until 8pm Wednesday-Saturday.

tips.label: Holiday
tips.text: Midtown Farmers Market at North Hills wrapped its Saturday season on Oct 31 and comes back for a holiday market on November 21, 2026.

tips.label: Winter Saturdays
tips.text: For a Saturday market all winter, Cary (160 E Park St) and Wake Forest both stay open every Saturday, 9am-12pm from November to March.

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog to the State Farmers Market?
faqs.answer: Leashed pets are welcome in the outdoor areas if you clean up after them, but not inside the buildings, sheds or shops. Only service animals may enter the selling areas.

faqs.question: Where do I park for the Midtown Farmers Market?
faqs.answer: Use the free underground garage at North Hills: coming off Six Forks Road, stay in the inside lane and take the ramp down. Elevators and escalators bring you up at the market.

faqs.question: Is there a farmers market in downtown Raleigh?
faqs.answer: Raleigh City Farm runs a farmstand at 800 N Blount St on Wednesdays, 4pm-7pm, from April to October. It takes SNAP, and SNAP shoppers can still use its pay-what-you-can pricing.

faqs.question: Where is the Black Farmers' Market in Raleigh?
faqs.answer: It meets at Southeast Raleigh Magnet High School, 2600 Rock Quarry Rd, on the 2nd and 4th Sundays from 1-4pm. Parking in the school lot is free, it takes SNAP, and pets stay home.

california/san-diego.title: San Diego Farmers Markets: Open Year-Round, Days and Hours
california/san-diego.description: {count} farmers markets in San Diego, CA with days and hours. Little Italy Mercato runs Saturdays and Wednesdays all year, and Hillcrest is every Sunday.

tips.label: Biggest
tips.text: Little Italy Mercato fills six blocks of W Date St (Kettner Blvd to Front St) every Saturday, 8am-2pm, rain or shine. A smaller Wednesday market runs 9:30am-1:30pm.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: On Saturdays the Washington Elementary lots near the Mercato charge $15 (248 W Date St) or $20 (400 W Fir St). The Waterfront garage at 1600 Pacific Hwy is $15 flat on weekends.

tips.label: Sunday
tips.text: Hillcrest's Sunday market (9am-2pm, over 175 vendors) has moved to 1601 University Ave, between Herbert St and Park Blvd, while the Normal St promenade is built.

tips.label: Free parking
tips.text: Street parking in Hillcrest is free on Sundays, and so is the DMV lot at Normal St and Lincoln Ave. MTS buses 1, 7, 10, 11 and 215 also stop near the market.

tips.label: Fresh fish
tips.text: Tuna Harbor Dockside Market sells fish off the boats Saturdays 8am-1pm or until sold out, at 598 Harbor Lane. Cutters will clean a whole fish, and some vendors take cash only.

tips.label: EBT
tips.text: At the Pacific Beach Tuesday market (2pm-7pm, 901 Hornblend St), swap EBT for Market Bucks at the info booth at Hornblend and Bayard, and ask about up to $15 in Market Match.

faqs.question: Is there an evening farmers market in San Diego?
faqs.answer: Ocean Beach runs every Wednesday, 4pm-8pm, rain or shine, on the 4900 block of Newport Ave. North Park's Thursday market runs 3pm-7:30pm on North Park Way between Ray St and Granada Ave.

faqs.question: Can I bring my dog to the Hillcrest Farmers Market?
faqs.answer: No. Pets are not allowed under the California Health and Safety Code, though service animals are welcome.

faqs.question: Does the Hillcrest market take EBT?
faqs.answer: Not at this time. Four farms there do take WIC checks: Smit Farms, Valley Center Growers, Ken's Top Notch and Heritage Family Farms.

faqs.question: Is there a farmers market at a winery in San Diego?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bernardo Winery in Rancho Bernardo hosts a market in its lower courtyard every Friday morning, 9am-1pm, with produce, artisan goods and food vendors.

wisconsin/madison.title: Madison Farmers Markets: Holiday and Winter Market Dates
wisconsin/madison.description: {count} farmers markets in Madison, WI. Dane County Farmers' Market moves indoors to Monona Terrace for the holidays, then to Garver Feed Mill Jan-Apr.

tips.label: Last Saturday
tips.text: Saturday on the Square wraps up its 2026 season on November 14, 6:15am-1:45pm, around the Capitol. Every vendor sells what they produce, so popular stalls can sell out early.

tips.label: Holiday
tips.text: The Holiday Market moves indoors to Monona Terrace (1 John Nolen Dr) on Saturdays Nov 21, Dec 5, 12 and 19, 7:30am-12pm. Dec 5 runs until 1pm, and there is no market Nov 28.

tips.label: Winter
tips.text: From January 2 to April 3, 2027, the Winter Market runs Saturdays 8am-12pm at Garver Feed Mill, 3241 Garver Green. Only Wisconsin farm products, no crafts.

tips.label: Parking
tips.text: Monona Terrace's on-site garage is $5 during the Holiday Market. Garver Feed Mill has over 100 free spots, and the Capital City Trail runs past both buildings.

tips.label: EBT
tips.text: On the Square, swap SNAP/EBT for market dollars at the Info Booth (the green tent) at the top of State St, 7am-1pm. Market dollars don't expire.

tips.label: Pets
tips.text: Dane County Farmers' Market allows no pets, not even a dog carried in your arms at Garver. Service animals are welcome. Northside's Sunday market lets leashed pets in.

faqs.question: Is there a farmers market in Madison on Wednesdays?
faqs.answer: Yes, in season. Dane County Farmers' Market ran Wednesdays April 22 to November 4 in 2026, 8:30am-1:15pm, on the 200 block of Martin Luther King Jr Blvd between the Municipal Building and the City County Building.

faqs.question: Is there an evening farmers market in Madison?
faqs.answer: The Eastside Farmers' Market runs Tuesdays 4pm-7pm, rain or shine, at McPike Park (202 S Ingersoll St). The 2026 season ran April 28 to October 27, and it takes EBT with Double Dollars.

faqs.question: Where is the Westside Community Market now?
faqs.answer: Inside University Research Park at 505 S Rosa Rd, with street parking on the east side of Rosa Rd and a lot by the MG&E Innovation Center. In 2026 it ran Saturdays 7am-12:30pm from April 11 to a bonus week on November 7.

faqs.question: Is there a Sunday farmers market in Madison?
faqs.answer: Northside Farmers Market runs Sundays 8:30am-12:30pm at Northside TownCenter, May 3 to October 25 in 2026. SNAP tokens there are worth $2 each, and parking in the center is plentiful.
